dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me, are there any events happening as of late?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: There have. Recently, the Angel's Share has been giving out complimentary Chicken-Mushroom Skewers, and we've been running a promotion in response.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Since we're the Cat's Tail, our main appetizer has to be Mondstadt Grilled Fish!

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Anyway, take these, and remember to swing by some time if you're free!

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Finally, I have the chance to stop you. I've had my eye on you for a while now — an outlander wandering the plaza is quite easy to spot.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well... ahh... Tell me about yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Me? I'm just a simple tavern owner.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: I'm sure you'd noticed my tavern, Cat's Tail, on your way here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just how are the taverns around here?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: I don't like to admit it but the best tavern in the city is Angel's Share.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: However, ever since I hired Diona as my bartender, business has been looking up.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Doesn't matter whether they came for the wine or for her... Money is flooding in now.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: So, you couldn't resist stopping by again, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's alright. Thanks again for your help with my little Princey.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: I'm waiting for someone to invite me for a drink at the tavern. Would that be you?

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Just kidding! Loosen up a little! Mondstadt is a city of romance~!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Leaving already? Don't forget to come see me when you come to Cat's Tail for a night out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: I must admit that though I'm glad we're all finally safe, I do feel just a bit unsatisfied.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: The Angel's Share was seriously affected by the dragon attacks as many of its popular drinks had their supplies cut.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Here at the Cat's Tail, we even had an ongoing discount to take further advantage...

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: ...But in the end, our sales were still a little less than theirs.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Still, there's not much I can do about that. It is supplied directly by the Dawn Winery, after all, which gives it an overwhelming advantage in terms of where they get their wine...
